{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grand Companies''' were the great trading conglomerates of [[the Spin]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Around [[17,000 BBY]], after [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] led other worlds along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] to block the Grand Companies' expansion, the Companies objected. They found support with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], providing a basis for the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] between the Republic and Alsakan.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
